thesis: The episode introduces Will Thorndyke, an author and investor who founded Housatonic Partners, and discusses his book The Outsiders, which is based on an eight-year research project studying CEOs like Henry Singleton, John Malone, Tom Murphy, Catherine Graham, and Warren Buffett.
